reviews.review:
Its actually a decent metroidvania, but plagued with a lot of issues that make it not fun to play.
The main issue most people will have is with how stiff the controls are to the point where I think there was an input buffer happening with any action button being pressed, i.e. pressing any action button locks you into that motion and you can't dash / move out of it so you gotta commit which just leads to tanking hits in fights.  This also applies to double jumping off of a hanging grab position where the 1st jump just gets disappears sometimes so you have to deliberately hit buttons slower for it to register what you are trying to do.  It takes some getting used to but its fine once you get used to it.

There are also other smaller issues such as hitting a door unlock in the middle of a fight sometimes pausing the fight action to show the unlocking of a door again even though you had already hit it and opened the door, black screens happening when moving to new screens, and for some reasons going up ramps sometimes gets you stuck on nothing.

I just think this was rushed out and needed more time to polish.
